page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.

The instance is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, providing a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of dual NVIDIA P4 GPUs provides entry-level hardware acceleration for workloads requiring parallel processing without the higher cost overhead of newer GPU architectures.

This instance is designed for workloads such as video transcoding, low-latency inference, entry-level machine learning, and general-purpose compute tasks that benefit from moderate GPU acceleration and a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio.
